entities.name: Chronic renal failure
observations: In solitary-kidney partial nephrectomy patients without preoperative renal insufficiency, the most directly relevant 13-center cohort found neither vascular clamping nor warm-ischemia time independently predicted long-term renal-function deterioration/chronic renal failure; preoperative GFR and blood loss were independent predictors.

A separate 362-patient cohort found continuous warm-ischemia time was not independently associated with new stage-IV CKD, although warm ischemia >25 minutes had a borderline adjusted association (HR 2.27, P=0.049).

entities.name: Ischemia not independent
observations: In a 13-center retrospective cohort of 259 solitary-kidney partial nephrectomy patients explicitly without preoperative renal insufficiency, vascular clamping (P=0.44) and warm-ischemia time (P=0.10) were not independent predictors of adverse long-term renal-function evolution/chronic renal failure in Cox analysis.

In a 660-patient cohort, ischemia duration lost significance after adjustment for percentage of preserved parenchyma; baseline GFR and preserved parenchyma were the main determinants of ultimate renal function.
A 45-patient cohort likewise did not identify ischemia time as an independent long-term predictor; tumor characteristics and preoperative GFR were reported predictors.

entities.name: Prolonged warm ischemia
observations: In a 362-patient solitary-kidney warm-ischemia cohort, warm-ischemia time independently predicted postoperative acute renal failure (P=0.021), but continuous warm-ischemia time did not independently predict new stage-IV CKD; warm ischemia >25 minutes was borderline associated with stage-IV CKD after adjustment (HR 2.27, P=0.049).

entities.name: Parenchymal preservation
observations: In an 841-patient solitary-kidney cohort, ischemia predicted postoperative AKI and reduced recovery-from-ischemia, but parenchymal volume preservation explained 69% of median GFR loss; ischemia and other factors accounted for approximately 3–4 mL/min/1.73m².
